verdict.rationale: Sprinto's quickstart claims continuous monitoring with alerts, so the product itself appears to alert on monitoring findings. Nothing in the pack shows those alerts reaching Slack, email, or a ticketing system, or what context they carry. The Jira and ClickUp integrations appear only as titles or as Change Management connections, the status-page emails cover Sprinto's own outages, and the webhooks are inbound only, so none of these count. Missing for 10: documented delivery of control-failure and drift alerts to Slack, email, or ticketing; alert content and remediation context; configuration docs; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, control failures and configuration drift alert me where I work — Slack, email, or ticketing — with enough context to fix the finding

citations.quote: Audit readiness by design: Maintain readiness with continuous monitoring, alerts, and evidence collection.
